lines.text: This is what happens if you open it early.
Grandma mailed it. Twenty-four doors and a note:
It was November 28th. I opened door one.
lines.say: It was November twenty-eighth. I opened door one.

lines.text: Inside, a tiny drawing of my house.
Door two: my front door. Wide open.
Door three: my hallway. Lights off.
Then I heard a tiny click.
Door four had opened by itself.
My room. Me, holding the calendar. Right now.
And in the doorway behind me, a tall shape.
I didn't turn around. Door five is open now.
